DIAGNOSIS: Generalized tonic-clonic seizure due to idiopathic generalized epilepsy, most consistent with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (generalized polyspike-and-wave discharges on EEG).

1. Juvenile absence epilepsy (idiopathic generalized epilepsy variant with absence seizures evolving to GTC)
2. Convulsive syncope (reflex anoxic seizure with myoclonic jerks) – less likely given the interictal generalized epileptiform discharges
3. Psychogenic non-epileptic seizure – unlikely given documented generalized polyspike-and-wave activity on EEG
